verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible left-to-right order (presenter → DEAN COOPER → title pill), but the patterned background is reduced to a tiny thumbnail with an empty white card and dots inside, so the brand pattern is mostly lost. The 'OPENING JANUARY 1' line is very small and pressed against the thumbnail edge. B is broken: 'THE MINIMALIST' pill sits over the busy pattern strip, 'OPENING…' runs into the pill, 'DDG STUDIO PRESENTS' is tiny and comes after the name it introduces, there is a stray empty white frame, and the pink dots are stranded at the canvas edges.
